text: การหมั้นหมายครั้งนั้น
style: Speak natural standard Central Thai (Bangkok) as a native Thai voice actor dubbing a Chinese costume drama; no foreign accent, clear tones, natural rhythm and polite particles only where written. A 50-year-old rich man of the prefectural city, male, a low voice: snobbish and sour, drawling slowly, enjoyin Line direction (written in Chinese; never read it aloud, speak only the Thai line): 低頭，快，說完就停
